_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #28345

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按你对 5 处遗留项的裁决（全部 A）改了测试清单：28 条只写范围说明、无法判定的否定项挪进 `source[]`；Studio 顶栏「已保存」不算写入反馈；Studio 不能填 `initialStates`，该判据移出验收；批量全选超过 5000 条时横幅必须写明上限；组织管理员保存已锁定的设置应被拒。
- 为什么改：这些条目要么让测试员只能记「跳过」，要么判据和产品实际能力不符，要么缺一条权限边界的判据；不改，每轮巡检都会给出假的通过或假的失败。
- 风险与回滚：只动 5 个清单 JSON 文件，不碰产品代码、不进任何发布包；每个改动的条目 revision +1 并追加一行 history。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` 的 `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` 新增 acceptance[5]；`platform-core.json` 的 `platform-core.settings-organization-isolation-and-platform-rung` 新增 negative[0]；`studio-authoring.json` 的 `validation-rules-authoring`。
- 两分钟验证：在仓库根运行 `pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期最后一行是 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 352 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Ruling-ref: 6545938831

Five checklist area files, no product code. Every edited item bumps `revision` by one and appends exactly one `history` row, dated 2026-11-01, `ref` #28345, naming wave anchor #27377. Main's history stays an exact prefix of each item's history. This was checked structurally: each file was re-parsed and compared with the original object plus the intended edit.

**① Scope-note negatives move out of `negative[]` (28 items).** Each moved entry was its item's last negative, so no other negative index shifts. Each lands as the item's new last `source[]` row, the field sibling items already use for cross-refs (the #27651 precedent). A leading `SCOPE:` label now reads `cross-ref:`. The rest of each text is unchanged.

- `studio-authoring.json`: all 24 active items whose last negative began `SCOPE:`.
- `platform-core.notification-center` negative[3] (`cross-ref:`).
- `access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop` negative[2] (`cross-ref:`).
- Same shape, different spelling: `access-security.record-view-read-audit` negative[2] (`cross-ref access-security.audit-log-browser …`). Its `automated.ref` called negative[2] a cross-reference, so that note now points at source[4].
- Same shape, different spelling: `records-forms.import-transform-matrix` negative[3] (`cross-ref guard: …`).

**② `ux-conventions.write-feedback` acceptance[1].verify.** The Studio top bar's save status ('Saved' / 「已保存」) names no item, so it is not write feedback. A Studio row passes only on a toast or inline text naming the item or package. A row whose only feedback is that status scores FAIL. The clause wording is unchanged.

**③ `studio-authoring.validation-rules-authoring`.** acceptance[3] no longer names `invalid_initial_state`, and steps[2] no longer asks for an initial state. A new `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` says why: Studio's Validations tab has no `initialStates` input, so the state can only be written through the API. `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` carries no `initialStates` at base 37184244. The insert-time code is still covered by `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix` variants[0]. This item's history merges its ① and ③ edits into one row.

**④ `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching`.** Adds acceptance[5] (dom oracle), steps[7] (a cap leg of more than 5000 scratch rows through `createMany`, at most 200 per call) and `fixtures.knownGaps[1]`. The new clause: past HARD_CAP 5000, the cross-page offer, the all-selected line and the selected count name the cap, for example 「将处理前 5000 条」. They must never present the uncapped total as the set the action processes. The clause is an expected FAIL today. The product defect card is owed, and the seat files it. No existing clause changed.

**⑤ `platform-core.settings-organization-isolation-and-platform-rung`.** Adds the item's first `negative[]`. LOCKED means platform-locked. After steps[2]'s lock, A's organization administrator saving the same key again must be refused, with the value unchanged and the row still locked on re-read. A 2xx is a security FAIL. It is a walled leg, `blocked(fixture)` when unprovisioned, like acceptance[2] and [3]. steps[2] now drives it. The live measure the ruling asks for was run, and its result went to the seat thread.

## Acceptance notes

- Left in `negative[]` on purpose, for the seat to rule on:
  - `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor` negative[3] ("out of scope here …"). Its `automated.ref` cites it by index.
  - `approvals.pending-count-surfaces` negative[1]. It carries a tracked product defect, objectui#4074, which fits `knownGaps` rather than a cross-ref.
  - `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` negative[1] and `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` negative[1]. These are carve-outs of their own criterion rather than pointers to a sibling item.
  - Two retired items: `dashboards.report-schedule-dispatch-delivery` negative[3] and `access-security.packaged-permission-set-lifecycle` negative[3]. A retired item never runs.
- The PM census figure of 38 counted every `SCOPE:` / `cross-ref:` string in the six files. The records-forms 7 and automation 3, and one of the dashboards 2, are already `source[]` rows, so there was nothing to move there.
- ② edits acceptance[1].verify only. acceptance[0] ("visible feedback") still lists "an inline status" without excluding the top bar.
- The `studio-authoring.expression-editors` mechanical fixes (vitest cwd, card refs, `record.FORMULA_FIELD` binding) are not taken. The census comment does not quote the exact text of its rows, so they stay with the seat's follow-up batch.

## Verification

Each moved entry was diffed against its new `source[]` row: the same bytes apart from the `SCOPE:` → `cross-ref:` label. Every history row was checked: one `#28345` row per item, equal to `revision`, citing #27377.
